### 🟢 Approval recommended The change is a small, well-scoped dashboard UI refactor with no broken references and comprehensive new test coverage for the dormant-override and shared-notice behaviors. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR improves the dashboard's Session Defaults settings so a saved provider override that the currently connected server does not offer is no longer silently normalized away. It now renders as a disabled, still-selected option plus an explanatory hint clarifying that the override stays stored and which provider is actually used locally. It also extracts the one-time "Session Defaults" migration notice into a shared `SessionDefaultsNotice` component so Settings and New Session render identical copy and share dismissal behavior. **Changes:** - Display a dormant saved provider override in Settings as a disabled selected `
